summary: ASX 200 drifted -0.09% to 9,263.6 in a flat, two-speed tape. Materials (+1.32%) led on lithium (LTR +9.26%) and record-high copper; Financials (-0.95%) and Health Care (-0.92%) offset. August reporting season drove moves: AVH +20.31% and JHX +5.78% on results, RMD -8.29% beat-but-sold. A domestic consumer/retail rotation tops Smart Money ahead of the RBA's widely-expected hold at 4.35% on Tue 11 Aug.
